purpose: Realistic student everyday outfit pieces across tops, bottoms, outers, shoes, hats, and bags at budget-to-mid pricing.

candidates.title: Champion Reverse Weave Hoodie Oxford Grey
candidates.fitNotes: Heavyweight reverse-weave fleece, ribbed side panels, script Champion logo, boxy fit
candidates.reasonForInclusion: Champion Reverse Weave is the most iconic campus hoodie; grey is the quintessential colorway

candidates.title: Levi's 501 Original Fit Jeans Medium Stonewash
candidates.fitNotes: Straight leg, high rise, button fly, medium blue stonewash, true original cut
candidates.reasonForInclusion: Levi's 501 is the foundational campus jean; medium wash is the most outfit-versatile denim

candidates.title: Uniqlo Supima Cotton Crew Neck T-Shirt White
candidates.fitNotes: Supima premium cotton, slim crew neck, very clean minimal construction, excellent fabric quality for price
candidates.reasonForInclusion: The baseline white tee; Uniqlo Supima is the best quality-to-price campus basic in the market

candidates.title: H&M Oversized Fit Cotton T-Shirt Black
candidates.fitNotes: Oversized boxy cut, drop shoulder, 100% cotton, very clean black finish
candidates.reasonForInclusion: Budget black oversized tee is the most worn campus piece; fills the budget top gap alongside white

candidates.title: Carhartt Watch Hat Beanie Black
candidates.fitNotes: 100% acrylic knit, ribbed construction, folded cuff, iconic Carhartt patch label
candidates.reasonForInclusion: Carhartt beanie is the most popular budget hat in campus/street culture; fills the hat gap in cold-weather builds

candidates.title: New Era 59FIFTY New York Yankees Fitted Cap Navy
candidates.fitNotes: 6 7/8 - 8 full fitted sizing, classic dome crown, embroidered team logo, flat brim
candidates.reasonForInclusion: NY Yankees fitted is the most recognizable streetwear hat; fills fitted cap gap in campus/streetwear builds

candidates.title: Gap Arch Logo Crewneck Sweatshirt Heather Grey
candidates.fitNotes: French terry fleece, arch logo graphic at chest, relaxed fit, very clean campus look
candidates.reasonForInclusion: Gap arch sweatshirt is a viral campus piece; grey crewneck fills the graphic top gap in campus builds

candidates.title: Levi's 511 Slim Fit Jeans Black
candidates.fitNotes: Slim fit, zip fly, stretch denim, modern campus silhouette, very clean in black
candidates.reasonForInclusion: Black 511 is the slim-fit campus jean complement to the 501; fills the slim-cut denim gap

candidates.title: Nike Club Fleece Sweatpants Dark Grey Heather
candidates.fitNotes: Classic fleece, relaxed fit, elastic waistband with drawstring, Swoosh embroidery, campus essential
candidates.reasonForInclusion: Grey Nike sweatpants are the single most-worn campus bottom; essential catalog staple

candidates.title: Patagonia Classic Retro-X Fleece Pullover Natural
candidates.fitNotes: High-pile polyester fleece, elastic collar/cuffs, relaxed fit, vintage Patagonia look
candidates.reasonForInclusion: Patagonia Retro-X fleece is iconic for campus/street builds; natural color is very photogenic

candidates.title: JanSport SuperBreak One Backpack Burgundy
candidates.fitNotes: 16L capacity, single main compartment, web haul handle, lifetime warranty
candidates.reasonForInclusion: JanSport SuperBreak is the most affordable campus bag; burgundy is a strong color option for campus outfits

candidates.title: Uniqlo Ultra Light Down Jacket Black
candidates.fitNotes: Packable puffer, 90/10 down fill, very minimal design, excellent warmth-to-weight ratio
candidates.reasonForInclusion: Uniqlo Ultra Light Down is the budget campus puffer staple; fills the affordable puffer gap

candidates.title: New Balance 574 Sneaker Beige
candidates.fitNotes: Same NB 574 classic silhouette in a warm sand/beige colorway — excellent campus outfit pairing
candidates.reasonForInclusion: Beige 574 complements the grey 574 (pack-02) with a warmer tone — very popular campus color

candidates.title: American Eagle AirFlex+ Straight Jeans Medium Wash
candidates.fitNotes: AirFlex 4-way stretch denim, straight leg, mid-rise, very comfortable campus jean
candidates.reasonForInclusion: AE is the campus jean brand for the 18-25 demographic; stretch straight fills the comfort denim gap

candidates.title: H&M Canvas Shopper Tote Bag Natural
candidates.fitNotes: 100% cotton canvas, wide carrying handles, simple open-top construction
candidates.reasonForInclusion: Budget canvas tote is a campus staple; fills the $0-25 bag gap that currently has no options
